'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
****[[March 2025 Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip]]
*****The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] conducts [[airstrikes]] and [[Artillery|artillery shelling]] across several regions of the [[Gaza Strip]], killing at least 404 [[Palestinians]] and wounding 560 more. The shellings represent the largest attack of the [[Gaza war]] since the beginning of a [[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|ceasefire]] which came into effect on 19 January. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-ceasefire-hostages-03-17-2025-b8753b9458a44f10ab08aa9b12582780 (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/18/israel-launches-gaza-assault-killing-hundreds-and-shattering-ceasefire (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***The Israeli military intercepts a [[ballistic missile]] fired by the [[Houthi]]s from [[Yemen]] at the [[Nevatim Airbase]] in southern Israel. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20250319-yemen-houthis-target-israels-nevatim-air-base-with-ballistic-missile/ (Middle East Monitor)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/houthis-fire-first-ballistic-missile-at-israel-in-2-months-warn-of-more-in-coming-days/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[Russia]]n [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Ministry of Defense]] claims that the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian Armed Forces]] attempted to launch an offensive on [[Belgorod Oblast]] with five assaults before being stopped by [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]], characterizing the alleged attacks as an attempt to discredit [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|peace negotiations]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-troops-allegedly-try-to-break-into-belgorod-oblast-russia-claims/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Attempted assassination of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]]
***At least ten people are killed and 20 others are injured in an [[assassination attempt]] by [[Al-Shabaab militant]]s targeting [[Somali President]] [[Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]] near [[Villa Somalia]] on the road to [[Aden Adde International Airport]] in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.idilnews.com/mogadishu-hassan-sheikh-mohamud-survived-assassination-attempted-by-al-shabaab/ (Idil News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[February 2025 Putin–Trump call]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] agree to an immediate [[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|energy infrastructure ceasefire]] in [[Ukraine]] during a phone call, with additional negotiations to begin immediately on a permanent settlement of the conflict. Putin stated that the end of all foreign military and intelligence support to Ukraine would be one condition of such a settlement. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/trump-talks-putin-ukraine-ceasefire-good-chance-success/story?id=119890671 (ABC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Nagpur violence]]
**A [[curfew]] is imposed in parts of [[Nagpur]] in [[Maharashtra]], [[India]], after [[Hindu nationalism|Hindu groups]] demanded the removal of the tomb of [[Aurangzeb]], a 17th-century [[Mughal Empire|Mughal]] [[List of emperors of the Mughal Empire|emperor]], sparking violence. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yx9gwg4ppo (BBC News)]
*The [[Peru]]vian [[Government of Peru|government]] declares a [[state of emergency]] in the capital city [[Lima]] and deploys [[Peruvian Armed Forces|military personnel]] to make [[patrol]]s to combat increased [[violent crime|violent]] [[Crime in Peru|crime rates]]. [https://apnews.com/article/peru-crime-lima-state-of-emergency-b515974f76179d96461a4091ea216d91 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[LGBTQ rights in Hungary]]
**The [[Parliament of Hungary|Hungarian parliament]] votes 136–27 to ban [[LGBTQ]] events in [[Hungary|the country]], including the annual [[Budapest Pride]] event. [https://www.dw.com/en/hungarys-parliament-passes-law-banning-lgbtq-pride-events/a-71964198 (DW)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Boeing Crew Flight Test]], [[SpaceX Crew-9]]
**Astronauts [[Sunita Williams]] and [[Barry Wilmore]] return to [[Earth]] aboard the [[SpaceX Crew-9]] [[Dragon 2]] capsule after nine months on the [[International Space Station]] (ISS). The astronauts were originally supposed to be aboard the ISS for eight days but their return was delayed due to technical problems with their [[Boeing Starliner]] ''[[Boeing Starliner Calypso|Calypso]]'' capsule. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c9de6q52g8qt (BBC News)]
